## Elytra Flight Control 1.0.0
A Minecraft mod (Fabric 1.20.1) that enhances elytra flight.

### Features
- Launch into elytra flight from the ground using fireworks
- Hold W while flying to continuously accelerate (up to 1.6)
- Hold S to slow down (minimum 0, no reversing)
- Vanilla gliding feel preserved when no key is pressed

### Dependencies
- Fabric Loader >= 0.16.9
- Fabric API (required)

### Installation
Put the jar into the mods folder
